name: Interpersonal Competence Scale
instruction: Rate how competent and comfortable you feel in carrying out each interpersonal situation (1 = Poor, 5 = Extremely good).

items.text: Initiating conversations with strangers or new acquaintances.
Asking someone out on a friendly or collaborative outing.
Introducing yourself to people you don't know well.
Disclosing intimate personal details to close friends.
Confiding in companions when you feel vulnerable.
Telling a companion you appreciate what they did for you.
Confronting a friend about irritating or unfair behavior.
Standing up for your rights when treated unfairly.
Saying 'no' politely when someone asks unreasonable favors.
Helping a friend manage and work through emotional distress.
Listening patiently when someone vents their troubles.
Giving helpful, comforting advice to a discouraged peer.
